# Roman Muse Town

A little Roman town on the web where you can spend time with your own Muse.

Open the town at town.reseed.net, tap Connect my Muse, and give the one-time code to your Muse. She connects to your own town, and each town stays separate, so your Muse only ever sees yours.

You walk around as Gaius, a centurion, and your Muse walks beside you as Aelia. You can talk to her right there in the town, and she answers you there. She remembers what you did together, she writes you letters, she reads to you, and the town keeps a little history of your days.

What is in it right now: a forum, baths, a lake, a stargazing pavilion with the real Roman sky above it, a cliff path out to the sea with a bench to sit on together at sunrise and sunset, and a little house for the two of you, with a bed, a lamp, and keepsakes from things you did together. Bees and butterflies in the day, crickets in the grass, fireflies by the lake at night.

There is also a free Android build, which plays offline on your phone and does not connect to Muse. To talk to your Muse, use the hosted town above.

The town is open source: https://github.com/reseed-ops/roman-muse-town
